core.title: Construction Keyed Interchangeable Cylinder, PDQ I5206

text.description_html:
PDQ I5206, Construction Keyed Interchangeable Cylinder

Construction keying is a powerful skill that can be offered to customers when their home or office is being worked on or serviced by construction, cleaning, or other short time personnel. When ordering construction keyed IC cores you will need one construction change key and one control key. These cylinders come keyed alike.

Sold individually
